debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term EMA structure (50/200 bullish) + Ichimoku above cloud + extreme oversold RSI (14.78) + contrarian fear-zone opportunity (VIX crisis) create potential reversal setup for patient swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Oversold RSI lacks bullish confirmation, price trapped below EMA-9/21 despite longer-term bullish alignment, MACD bearish with negative histogram, three black crows pattern signals continuation, weak volume (OBV false), and unfavourable macro (VIX 375.2 crisis + earnings risk in 39 days) make this a premature entry with asymmetric downside risk.
